name: Totalán (Spain)
description: Green field with three blue wavy stripes across the lower half, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Totalán (a tower on green above waves).
history: Totalán has had its own arms since 1987, although they were not made official until 2017; a year later its flag was approved. Both were entered in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales. When the flag has the proportion of length equal to 2/3 of the width, the axis of the arms is placed at a distance of half the width from the hoist.
